extracted.stage: Before grant of probate; inheritance tax due
extracted.summary: An executor of his late mother's estate, mostly a Harrogate house worth about £622k, asks to borrow around £40k to pay inheritance tax before the grant of probate is issued.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry about funding inheritance tax on your late mother's estate. We have noted that the estate is largely the property in Harrogate valued at around £622,000, that approximately £40,000 of inheritance tax is payable, and that Rowe & Gallagher Solicitors are instructed. To take this further we would need a copy of the will, confirmation of your appointment as executor, a schedule of the estate's assets and liabilities, the property valuation, the IHT400 or computation showing the tax figure, any payment deadline date, and your solicitor's contact details along with your consent for us to speak with them. Once those are with us a member of the team will review the enquiry and come back to you. Please note this acknowledgement is not an offer of funding and no decision has been made at this stage.
